title: R-2. Oblivion Steams - Comic Image Supreme Collector Cards Luis Royo 1996
descriptionText: The product is a rare and highly sought-after trading card from the "Heavy Metal" franchise, manufactured by Comic Images in 1996. The card features an insert design and is made of metal, making it a valuable and unique addition to any collector's card collection. Known as card number R-6, this non-sport trading card showcases the distinctive artwork of Luis Royo, adding to its appeal to fans of the comic genre.
